1: Snow Village (1)
Ling Jiushi, a VR game designer, unexpectedly receives a beta disc for a "Spirit Realm", an underground new game. After an accident, he finds himself in a corridor with twelve iron doors.
Snow Village (2)
Ling Jiushi learns more about the snowy world and the mysterious injured person.
Snow Village (3)
The group visit the village carpenter and are instructed to head up the mountain to collect logs for a coffin.
Snow Village (4)
Ruan Baijie and Ling Jiushi start to unravel the rules of the snowy world.
Snow Village (5)
Only four players remain in the snow village as plans are made and the coffin is completed.
Snow Village (6)
Ruan Baijie and Ling Jiushi piece together the mystery at the heart of the village.
Snow Village (7)
After escaping the snow village, Lin Jiushi meets up with Ruan Baijie.
Fitcher's Bird (1)
Ling Jiushi sees past players die from accidents, realizing he cannot refuse the doors. He is transported to a 1985 elevator room for the challenge.
Fitcher's Bird (2)
Players receive eggs at a birthday party for triplets. The eggs are the door’s taboo condition, and accidents occur that night.
Fitcher's Bird (3)
Zeng Ruguo goes mad and attacks Shen Yixian; the egg breaks, triggering death. Ling Jiushi experiences hallucinations confirming the taboo condition.
Fitcher's Bird (4)
Ling Jiushi discovers the true nature of the eggs. After surviving an attack, he uncovers the identity of a boy in his hallucinations.
Fitcher's Bird (5)
Moved by Ruan Lanzhu’s trust, Ling Jiushi joins Black Obsidian. Birthday party chaos reveals three overlapping timelines and a mission to change fate.
Fitcher's Bird (6)
The group uses a time machine to prevent Shen Yixian’s mother from being killed, and the key appears.
Sister Drum (1)
Ling Jiushi moves into Black Obsidian Villa, learning the difficulty rises with each door. The next clue is the human-skin drum.
Sister Drum (2)
New player Xu Jin joins, and Ling Jiushi navigates a creepy exhibit with Meng Yu and Ruan Lanzhu.
Sister Drum (3)
Inside the exhibit, a mural tells of a sister searching for her sibling. Needle rain kills disobedient players, and the day ends back at the base.
Sister Drum (4)
In a tower, Ling Jiushi is trapped in a painful hallucination. Ruan Lanzhu finds a notebook, and blood footprints appear overnight.
Sister Drum (5)
Ling Jiushi solves a riddle from an old woman and suspects the bride-costumed monster on the roof is the missing sister.
Sister Drum (6)
Xu Jin reveals her true form and uses drum-induced illusions. Ling Jiushi is saved by Ruan Lanzhu.
Sister Drum (7)
Ling Jiushi uses drum sounds to scare Xu Jin away, the key appears, and the monster is captured on the exhibit roof. A new player arrives.
Satchan (1)
Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu enter the Satchan gate, realizing a series of hidden deaths in the school.
Satchan (2)
Tan Zaozao is revealed as a celebrity and the team receives new clues to the Satchan gate.
Satchan (3)
Ling Jiushi confronts X Organization’s fake leader and discovers secret hard drives.
Satchan (4)
The team navigates a high school gate, uncovering cursed award certificates and hidden student records.
Satchan (5)
Following a blood-written song, the team investigates a series of student accidents tied to Sazi.
Satchan (6)
Ling Jiushi discovers deadly clues in the school and bloodied walls, revealing dark intentions.
Satchan (7)
The team deciphers a spiritual clue in the archives, racing to uncover Satchan’s story before the semester ends.
Satchan (8)
Ling Jiushi experiences Satchan's torment, prompting the team to investigate bullying and curses.
Satchan (9)
Satchan's death sparks mysterious retaliations, revealing the true instigator behind the class’s misdeeds.
Satchan (10)
Ling Jiushi uncovers the truth behind Satchan's photo and classmates’ deaths, finding a clue to the key.
Satchan (11)
The tragic story of Satchan is revealed, and deception within the group triggers deep anger.
Sanatorium (1)
Ling Jiushi assesses players’ mental states, teaming with Ruan Lanzhu to survive the first gate.
Sanatorium (2)
Ling Jiushi and friends prepare for the third gate, with rival groups maneuvering for advantage.
Sanatorium (3)
Tan Zaozao enters the third gate, while Ling Jiushi saves a teammate from a deadly trap.
Sanatorium (4)
Manipulation and hidden attacks threaten the team, who focus on a morgue to uncover critical clues.
Sanatorium (5)
Ling Jiushi tracks the vengeful nurse, using strategic observation to prevent further deaths.
Sanatorium (6)
Ruan Lanzhu discovers the key tool, following a suspicious figure to reveal the director’s plot.
Sanatorium (7)
A doll is secured in Obsidian as Ling Jiushi is recognized as a promising player, while others’ mental states falter.
Obsidian
Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu commit to finishing the game while avoiding X Organization’s traps.
Woman of the Rain (1)
Ling Jiushi enters the Woman of the Rain gate, uncovering unusual paintings and the mysterious presence of the female owner.
Woman of the Rain (2)
Ling Jiushi discovers the stakes in the painting world as illusions blur reality, exposing a fake Tan Zaozao.
Woman of the Rain (3)
Clues hidden in paintings lead the team to uncover possible plagiarism and protect their positions in the game.
Woman of the Rain (4)
Ling Jiushi rescues a trapped friend from a painting, uncovering betrayals within the group.
Woman of the Rain (5)
Ling Jiushi narrowly escapes the female antagonist after grabbing the key, waking up in Obsidian Villa.
Woman of the Rain (6)
Ling Jiushi learns Ruan Lanzhu risked everything for him, uncovering matching scars and deeper mysteries.
Night Crying Baby (1)
Ling Jiushi witnesses a festival as part of the Night Crying Baby Gate, with hidden dangers lurking within.
Night Crying Baby (2)
Ling Jiushi learns the festival is a trap as he enters the Night Crying Baby Gate, protected by Li Dongyuan.
Night Crying Baby (3)
A murderous intruder and sinister rituals reveal the grim truth of the manor and the missing children.
Night Crying Baby (4)
Ling Jiushi discovers children’s memorials hiding dark secrets, uncovering the abuse behind the Night Crying Baby Gate.
Night Crying Baby (5)
The team uncovers clues in a university-like room, avoiding a trap set by Yan Shihe while identifying the oil thief.
Night Crying Baby (6)
Ling Jiushi investigates a hallucinatory plot caused by tainted oil, revealing the true dangers of the Night Cry Gate.
Night Crying Baby (7)
A tense reunion triggers a hidden game clue, as Li Dongyuan sacrifices himself to protect Ling Jiushi from an ambush.
The Death of Li Dongyuan (1)
Ling Jiushi seeks revenge for Li Dongyuan’s death, discovering X Organization’s deadly motives and reflecting on past games.
The Death of Li Dongyuan (2)
Ling Jiushi learns of a new X Organization member entering the gate and searches for answers to cryptic clues.
Saoqing Niang (1)
Entering the “Saoqing Niang” gate, Ling Jiushi realizes his enemies are disguised, starting a suspenseful journey.
Saoqing Niang (2)
Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu uncover a small path and manipulate rainfall, discovering hidden threats along the way.
Saoqing Niang (3)
A magical umbrella provides a safe space as Ling Jiushi navigates dangers, revealing the identity of a would-be assassin.
Saoqing Niang (4)
Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu follow clues at a school, surviving attacks and discovering a hidden message within a water tank.
Tan Zaozao (1)
Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu attend a film premiere and are invited to Tan Zaozao’s award ceremony, sparking new challenges.
Tan Zaozao (2)
At an award ceremony, Ling Jiushi faces tragedy as Tan Zaozao is killed, leaving him a cryptic message to continue the mission.
Hako Onna (1)
Ling Jiushi gears up for the complex tenth gate, learning the deadly table game that can turn players into killers.
Hako Onna (2)
The team starts the box-filled mansion game with limited knowledge of its deadly rules, discovering a hidden insider.
Hako Onna (3)
Misleading clues and the Box Demon’s deceptions test Ling Jiushi’s instincts, prompting the players to cooperate to survive.
Hako Onna (4)
Ling Jiushi risks his life to save Ruan Lanzhu from Box Demon’s control, showing the cost of protecting friends.
Hako Onna (5)
The team uses clues to uncover the Box Demon’s inner agent while dangerous tools and skills complicate the mission.
Hako Onna (6)
With the Box Demon’s trunk appearing, Ling Jiushi cracks the safe code, and the team deduces the insider is Tian Guxue.
Hako Onna (7)
Ling Jiushi identifies Box Demon’s emerging threat and realizes Ruan Lanzhu is trapped, triggering a frantic rescue mission.
Hako Onna (8)
Desperation strikes Ling Jiushi as Ruan Lanzhu bids farewell, while the team uncovers missing items linked to the traitor.
Hako Onna (9)
Ling Jiushi uncovers the second inside agent, Xia Ji, and narrowly avoids a deadly attack thanks to Ruan Lanzhu.
Hako Onna (10)
Secrets are revealed as Ruan Lanzhu’s fake death exposes the real traitor, while friends make emotional farewells at Obsidian Villa.
Hyakki Yagyo (1)
Ling Jiushi uncovers past game drafts and starts forming a bold hypothesis to understand the mysterious game.
Hyakki Yagyo (2)
Ling Jiushi realizes Ruan Lanzhu may be a game NPC with a fatal mission, prompting him to leave Obsidian in anger.
Hyakki Yagyo (3)
Ling Jiushi is urged to honor his fallen friend as the final X Organization leaders enter the eleventh gate.
Hyakki Yagyo (4)
Ling Jiushi revisits his old home within the game, narrowly escaping an ambush with help from Li Dongyuan, and reaches the Obsidian Villa.
Hyakki Yagyo (5)
Ling Jiushi is repeatedly attacked while searching for Ruan Lanzhu, but timely rescues lead to a critical discovery about the hidden key.
Hyakki Yagyo (6)
A tense standoff unfolds as Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu race to find the correct exit before rival Yan Balang tricks them into deadly traps.
Hyakki Yagyo (7)
Ling Jiushi and Ruan Lanzhu face a bittersweet goodbye as Ruan sacrifices himself in the game, leaving Ling confronted with a reality where their friends don’t recognize him.
Hyakki Yagyo (8)
After 30 years of research, Ling Jiushi finally tests his VR invention and reunites emotionally with his old friend Ruan Lanzhu.
